Messages.Author: Jeroen
Messages.Body:
Hi,

I have a question about semantics.

Brinksmanship: [...]Any Methuselah who has exhausted his or her
library and begins his or her untap phase with less than a full hand
must attempt to withdraw. [...].

Does this mean that this card changes his ability to order all "during
untap"-effects? After untapping all tapped cards, is the attempt to
withdraw a mandatory first action? Or can he still do other untap
stuff before announcing to withdraw?

grtz,
Jeroen

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
Jeroen wrote:
> Hi,
>
> I have a question about semantics.
>
> Brinksmanship: [...]Any Methuselah who has exhausted his or her
> library and begins his or her untap phase with less than a full hand
> must attempt to withdraw. [...].
>
> Does this mean that this card changes his ability to order all "during
> untap"-effects? After untapping all tapped cards, is the attempt to

No.

> withdraw a mandatory first action? Or can he still do other untap
> stuff before announcing to withdraw?

Attempting to withdraw can only be done when a Methuselah begins
his or her untap phase with less than a full hand.

The announcement is made during the untap phase.
